Water-quality observations in river order

286 compatible measure comparisons across 25 same-day activity pairs. Direction is SV-833 → RS-26250 → SV-735 → SV-111, established from the original directed NLDI reaches and station COMIDs.

Each difference is downstream minus upstream. Same-day samples were collected at different clocks: the signed local-clock gaps range from -176 to 179 minutes. Original timezone labels are retained. These offsets describe collection order, not travel time.

275 historical and 10 current comparisons are retained from the published source packages; one additional current total-nitrogen contrast subtracts the already retained same-activity TKN + nitrate/nitrite sums. There is no compatible same-day pair involving RS-26250 in these sources.

Repeated observations with matching support

The best repeated coverage is SV-833 → SV-735 under the original NPS-2013 project. Historical pairs span 2021–2023; the 2026 successor is a single January day. The counts below preserve the original analytical support and sampling dates.

  • Temperature, water: higher downstream on 18 of 18 sampled pairs, lower on 0, equal on 0 and unresolved from reporting limits on 0. Mean difference 1.43778 deg C; 2021-01-20 to 2023-03-23.
  • Dissolved oxygen (DO): higher downstream on 3 of 18 sampled pairs, lower on 15, equal on 0 and unresolved from reporting limits on 0. Mean difference -0.188889 mg/L; 2021-01-20 to 2023-03-23.
  • Escherichia coli: higher downstream on 12 of 18 sampled pairs, lower on 4, equal on 1 and unresolved from reporting limits on 1. Mean difference (−∞, +∞) MPN/100mL; 2021-01-20 to 2023-03-23.
  • Phosphorus: higher downstream on 15 of 18 sampled pairs, lower on 2, equal on 0 and unresolved from reporting limits on 1. Mean difference (0.0257222, 0.0390556) mg/L; 2021-01-20 to 2023-03-23.
  • Reconstructed total nitrogen: higher downstream on 12 of 17 sampled pairs, lower on 3, equal on 0 and unresolved from reporting limits on 2. Mean difference (0.0788235, 0.114118) mg/L; 2021-01-20 to 2023-03-23.

The January 2026 revisit

SV-833 was sampled at 12:37 and SV-735 at 13:15 on 14 January 2026, both labelled EDT in the source. Agreeing repeated result rows count once per activity and characteristic; each distinct original ResultIdentifier remains available. A single revisit cannot establish an interannual trend.
